title: Humanoid robot progress is real, but broad usefulness remains distant
friendlyTitle: Smart robots are improving, but they are not ready for every job
summary: AI-powered robot policies can now handle increasingly complex demonstrations, but researchers say today’s systems remain brittle outside their training data. Humanlike appearance should not be confused with the ability to perform a wide range of physical tasks reliably.
friendlySummary: Robots can now learn some difficult actions from examples, but they often fail when a task is different from what they saw during training.
whyItMatters: Businesses and households should separate impressive demonstrations from deployable capability. Near-term value is likelier in narrow, controlled tasks than in general-purpose home robots.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Expect useful robots first in clear, controlled jobs. A robot that looks human is not yet able to work like a person in every situation.
